name: GNSS视觉形态确认与数值精确定位实验
method_label: SG-LocFusion（单图形态确认与数值定位融合）
primary_endpoint: four-type macro daily F1: pool TP/FP/FN within each type, then average four type F1 scores equally; no point adjustment
secondary_endpoints: four-type macro event F1 at IoU 0.5
step exact-day and tolerance 3 days F1
activity coverage and post-arrest false days
selection: After 24 fresh validation stations, before generating or inspecting fresh test seeds: highest prespecified four-type daily F1 among the registered image/date/boundary variants. Complete development matrix retained.
adjustments: single global plot with unchanged numerical proposal text
minimum 5 observed samples on each side
note: Project GNSS adaptation, not reproduction of VLM4TS or ChangePointCNN-GNSS. No cross-station physical alarm threshold.
